subject.title: fix(gateway): keep hot reload subsystems consistent during channel deferral

question: Should this PR merge only after exact-head live proof covers the expanded transaction and recovery path, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate based on the focused tests?
rationale: The implementation appears correct from source and tests, but the supplied live transcript predates material current-head lifecycle changes, and repository policy treats external-PR real behavior proof as a merge gate.

options.title: Require refreshed live proof
options.body: Refresh onto current main and require redacted exact-head runtime output for deferred success and post-commit recovery before merge.

options.title: Override with test evidence
options.body: Explicitly accept the broad focused test matrix without current-head live proof and own the residual lifecycle risk.

recommendation.title: Require refreshed live proof
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main and require redacted exact-head runtime output for deferred success and post-commit recovery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current transaction, is assigned to the PR, and is best positioned to judge whether its focused tests justify a proof override.
